cohort: Pregnant patients diagnosed with medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD) who received prenatal care and delivered at a single academic institution between January 2017 and July 2023.
finding: Patients on MOUD who received antenatal anesthesia consultation reported statistically significant lower rates of severe postpartum pain in the first 24 hours compared to those without consultation.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as an independent predictor of severe postpartum pain in the first 24 hours after delivery.
